v2.2.0 - when the words will not come, your own hero finds them for you.
THINK (Shift+Enter), in the chat and letter windows * Your own character works out what to say - or write - next, and the words land in your writing box, yours to keep, change or throw away * Nothing is sent until you send it * They think from what YOU would know: who the person before you is, how they stand toward you, where you both are, and every word the two of you have exchanged - never from that person's private mind * Leave the box empty and they find something worth saying from the moment itself - a continuation, or an opening with someone you have never spoken to * Half-type a rant and it comes back as words a person would actually say, in the language you two speak
CONVERSATION PRESETS * Standing wishes that steer the thinking: "something romantic", "a courteous way to end this" * Three to start with (starter, romantic, ender), a scrollable menu, and an Edit page to add, rework or strike out your own * Restore the first three whenever you like - it asks first * A chosen preset is a wish, never a message: the box says so and Send stays shut until you make the words your own * Enter sends, Shift+Enter thinks - fixed, and written on the buttons * Toggle: EnableThinkForMe
Full model guide: github.com/TraxData313/ImmersiveAI/blob/master/docs/choosing-a-model.md
